## Change / 变更

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and affected pages or metadata.
说明问题、变更后的行为及受影响的页面或元数据。

## Validation / 验证

- [ ] English and Chinese guides and navigation updated / 中英文指南与导航已同步
- [ ] Foundation, original legal texts, and published artifact bytes preserved / 基础项目、原法律文本及已发布文件字节保留
- [ ] No private entitlements, credentials, or customer data included / 不含私有授权、凭据或客户数据
- [ ] `python3 tools/check_repository.py` passed / 仓库检查通过

Include the relevant validation output and any unresolved limitations.
附相关验证结果与尚未解决的限制。
